quote: File names use kebab-case (example: `pane-app-manager.ts`).
statement: In all source files, file names must use kebab-case (e.g. pane-app-manager.ts).

quote: Use `PascalCase` for exported types/classes and `camelCase` for functions/variables.
statement: In all TypeScript files, exported types and classes must be named in PascalCase.

quote: Use `PascalCase` for exported types/classes and `camelCase` for functions/variables.
statement: In all TypeScript files, functions and variables must be named in camelCase.

quote: Keep public exports intentional in `src/index.ts`.
statement: In src/index.ts, public exports must be intentionally curated (no accidental or wholesale re-exports).

quote: Do not manually edit generated `src/theme/builtin-themes.ts`; run `bun run build:themes` instead.
statement: src/theme/builtin-themes.ts must not be hand-edited; it must only change via the generator scripts/generate-builtin-themes.ts from assets/themes/manifest.json.

quote: Do not manually edit generated `src/wasm/embedded.ts`; run `bun run build:wasm` instead.
statement: src/wasm/embedded.ts must not be hand-edited; it must only change via scripts/build-wasm.ts.

quote: `reference/` is upstream/reference material (including Ghostty source and text-shaper source code); check there when you need to inspect them, and avoid routine edits.
statement: Files under reference/ (upstream Ghostty and text-shaper sources) should not be edited routinely.

quote: Framework: `bun:test`.
statement: In tests, test code must use the bun:test framework (import from "bun:test").

quote: Place tests in `tests/` and name files `<feature>.test.ts`.
statement: Test files must live in tests/ and be named <feature>.test.ts.

quote: Write behavior-driven test names (for example, `mapKeyForPty normalizes ...`).
statement: In tests, test names should be behavior-driven, naming the unit and the behavior (e.g. "mapKeyForPty normalizes ...").

quote: Add regression tests for any renderer/input/theme/font behavior change.
statement: Any behavior change in src/renderer, src/input, src/theme or src/fonts must be accompanied by a regression test in tests/.

quote: "categories": { "correctness": "error" } (plugins: unicorn, typescript)
statement: In all linted files (src, playground, scripts, tests), all oxlint correctness-category rules (including unicorn and typescript plugins) are errors.
scope: src/**, playground/**, scripts/**, tests/** all files

quote: "categories": { "suspicious": "error" } (plugins: unicorn, typescript)
statement: In all linted files (src, playground, scripts, tests), all oxlint suspicious-category rules (including unicorn and typescript plugins) are errors.
scope: src/**, playground/**, scripts/**, tests/** all files

quote: "unicorn/no-new-array": "off"
statement: In all linted files, `new Array(n)` is allowed; unicorn/no-new-array is not enforced.

quote: "unicorn/consistent-function-scoping": "off"
statement: In all linted files, nested functions that do not capture outer scope need not be hoisted; unicorn/consistent-function-scoping is not enforced.

quote: "unicorn/no-array-sort": "off"
statement: In all linted files, in-place Array.prototype.sort() is allowed (toSorted() not required); unicorn/no-array-sort is not enforced.

quote: "no-shadow": "off"
statement: In all linted files, variable shadowing is allowed; no-shadow is not enforced.

quote: "no-underscore-dangle": "off"
statement: In all linted files, identifiers with leading/trailing underscores are allowed; no-underscore-dangle is not enforced.

quote: low-level domains (`renderer`, `fonts`, `pty`, `theme`, `wasm`, `selection`, `ime`, `grid`, `unicode`, `utils`) do not depend on `runtime` or `surface`
statement: In src/renderer, src/fonts, src/pty, src/theme, src/wasm, src/selection, src/ime, src/grid, src/unicode and src/utils, code must not import from src/runtime or src/surface.

quote: `runtime` cannot import `surface`
statement: In src/runtime/**, code must not import any module under src/surface/.
enforced_by: tests/architecture-guards.test.ts "runtime source does not import surface modules"

quote: `runtime` must not re-export `surface`
statement: In src/runtime/**, modules must not re-export anything from src/surface.
enforced_by: tests/architecture-guards.test.ts "runtime source does not import surface modules"

quote: `surface` depends on `ResttyRuntime` and `createResttyRuntime(...)`, not on concrete runtime implementation files
statement: In src/surface/**, code must depend on the ResttyRuntime contract and createResttyRuntime() factory, not import concrete runtime implementation files (e.g. src/runtime/create-runtime/*).
enforced_by: tests/architecture-guards.test.ts "surface source does not import runtime create-runtime internals"

quote: old high-level option/type names are removed rather than aliased
statement: In src/**, renamed high-level option/type names (ResttyOptions, ResttyAppOptions, ResttyPaneAppOptionsInput) must be removed, not kept as type aliases of ResttyConfig, ResttyRuntimeConfig, ResttyTerminalConfig.

quote: internal code should not carry compatibility adapters for renamed public fields
statement: In src/**, internal code should not include compatibility adapters mapping old renamed public config fields to new ones.

quote: avoid patterns like `Omit<ResttyAppOptions, ...>` as the core public/internal bridge
statement: In src/surface/** and public config types, the public/internal config bridge should not be derived via Omit<ResttyAppOptions, ...> (omission-based config derivation).

quote: `surface` should not invent a second parallel runtime option vocabulary
statement: In src/surface/**, code should pass ResttyTerminalConfig through to runtime rather than defining a separate parallel option vocabulary.

quote: Legacy/raw accessors may remain temporarily but should be marked for deprecation: `getPanes()` `getPaneById()` `getActivePane()` `getFocusedPane()`
statement: In the Restty public class, legacy accessors getPanes(), getPaneById(), getActivePane(), getFocusedPane() should be marked deprecated; panes(), pane(id), activePane(), focusedPane() are the preferred accessors.

quote: `getRawPane()` should not be presented as part of the stable ergonomic API. If it remains, it should be explicitly marked unstable.
statement: In the public Restty/pane API, getRawPane() should be explicitly marked unstable and not presented as stable API.

quote: `Restty` active-pane convenience methods should implement `ResttyPaneTerminalApi`
statement: In src/surface, Restty's active-pane convenience methods should implement the ResttyPaneTerminalApi type.
enforced_by: tests/architecture-guards.test.ts "surface active pane api derives from pane handle contract"

quote: `ResttyPaneHandle` should extend `ResttyPaneTerminalApi` with pane-targeted methods such as `id`, `resize`, `focus`, and `blur`
statement: In src/surface, the ResttyPaneHandle type should extend ResttyPaneTerminalApi, adding id, resize, focus and blur.

quote: prefer composition over inheritance internally, even if the exported shape remains the same
statement: In src/surface internals, Restty should be built by composition (e.g. an active-pane controller) rather than class inheritance.

quote: no re-export of the full implementation graph by default; no export of `surface` internals that are only used by the playground; no export of helper modules whose only consumers are runtime implementation files
statement: In src/internal.ts and src/internal/*, the barrel must not wholesale re-export the implementation graph, surface internals used only by the playground, or runtime-only helper modules.
enforced_by: tests/architecture-guards.test.ts "src/internal.ts does not import runtime or surface modules directly"

quote: `create-runtime.ts` should only compose subsystems and expose the runtime API; implementation helpers should live in subfolders
statement: src/runtime/create-runtime.ts should only compose subsystems and expose the runtime API; implementation helpers should live in subfolders of src/runtime/.

quote: `terminal` config should describe terminal behavior only. It should not carry service wiring or DOM ownership.
statement: ResttyTerminalConfig should contain only terminal behavior settings; ptyTransport, callbacks, status DOM, session, canvas and IME must belong to services/mount config, not terminal config.

quote: define a `ResttyRuntime` interface owned by `runtime/core`; define `createResttyRuntime(...)` as the single runtime factory entrypoint
statement: The ResttyRuntime interface should be defined in src/runtime/core and createResttyRuntime() should be the single runtime factory entrypoint.

quote: move status panels, shell overlays, and other optional DOM concerns into adapters owned by `surface` or playground code
statement: In src/runtime core, code should not own status panels, shell overlays or other optional DOM; mount is limited to canvas and IME input.

quote: consolidate plugin runtime, types, dispatch, and host logic under one `surface/plugins/` area
statement: Plugin runtime, types, dispatcher and host files must live under src/surface/plugins/.

quote: the playground must consume public exports from `restty`, not `../src/internal.ts`
statement: In playground/**, code must not import src/internal.ts.
enforced_by: tests/architecture-guards.test.ts "playground source does not import src/internal.ts"

quote: make playground features express real product use cases through public `restty` exports
statement: In playground/**, code must import restty only through public exports (src/index.ts / "restty"), not from src/surface/** or src/runtime/** modules.
enforced_by: tests/architecture-guards.test.ts "playground source uses public restty exports only"

quote: do not couple the playground to raw managed pane internals
statement: In playground/**, code must not use raw managed pane internals (e.g. getRawPane / ResttyManagedPane).

quote: built playground artifacts must not be committed to source control
statement: Generated playground build output must live in playground/dist/ and not be committed; playground/public/ holds only authored static assets.
enforced_by: tests/architecture-guards.test.ts "playground keeps generated output out of source and static assets authored"

quote: source code moves to `playground/app/`; docs content moves to `playground/content/docs/`; static assets remain under `playground/public/`
statement: Playground source code must live in playground/app/, MDX docs in playground/content/docs/, and static assets in playground/public/.

quote: public entrypoints should not reach through unstable folders unless that export is intentional
statement: Public entrypoints (src/index.ts, src/xterm.ts) should not import through unstable internal folders unless the export is intentional.

quote: Do not capture the whole `context` object in long-lived closures.
statement: In merged pane runtime config wrappers, long-lived closures must not capture the whole pane context object; only primitives like paneId.

quote: `beforeInput` / `beforeRenderOutput` wrappers must use `paneId` only.
statement: beforeInput and beforeRenderOutput wrapper closures (and the desktop notification wrapper) must reference only paneId from the pane context.

quote: `sourcePane` remains available to user terminal/services factory execution at creation time, but internal wrappers never retain it.
statement: Internal pane wrappers must never retain a reference to sourcePane.

quote: `destroy()` should aggressively break references to large objects: release font lease; reset/clear font state arrays/maps; clear configured source arrays and transient promises
statement: Runtime destroy() should release the font lease and clear font state arrays/maps, configured source arrays and transient promises.

quote: Do not reuse `selectionColor`. Search and selection need distinct semantics and precedence.
statement: Search highlighting must use searchColor / searchSelectedColor and must not reuse selectionColor.
scope: src/renderer/**, src/runtime/**, src/theme/** search highlight code

quote: Never scan the full history in one JS task.
statement: Search code must never scan the full scrollback history in a single JS task; it must step incrementally.

quote: `restty_search_step` must accept a bounded budget.
statement: The restty_search_step WASM export must take a bounded work budget argument and return whether more work remains.

quote: Keep the viewport result format flat and renderer-friendly. Do not expose internal Ghostty page/search structures directly.
statement: Search results exposed from WASM must be a flat row/start_col/end_col/selected format and must not expose internal Ghostty page/search structures.

quote: Real terminal search should live in the Zig/WASM side and expose search results back to JS.
statement: Full terminal search should be implemented in the Zig/WASM core, not as a JS text mirror of scrollback.

quote: Do not invent a new text rendering mode.
statement: The renderer must render search matches as explicit search spans, not via a new text rendering mode.

quote: No SDF/MSDF path (removed; raster atlas only).
statement: In src/renderer and src/fonts, glyph rendering must use raster atlases only; no SDF/MSDF rendering path.

quote: Cursor/selection rendered as overlays to avoid breaking ligatures.
statement: In src/renderer, cursor and selection must be drawn as overlays on top of shaped glyphs rather than splitting ligature runs.

quote: Keep shader and buffer layout compatible across backends.
statement: In src/renderer, WebGPU and WebGL2 backends should keep shader and buffer layouts compatible.

quote: Keep separate atlas per font to avoid mixed metrics.
statement: In src/fonts and src/runtime atlas code, each font should have its own glyph atlas.

quote: Prefer GPU rendering with WebGPU first and WebGL2 fallback (`src/renderer/`).
statement: In src/renderer, backend selection should try WebGPU first and fall back to WebGL2.
